name: Tech Race
description: A rival with twice your capital is sprinting toward the electronics future. Out-research them: run two R&D centres, put televisions and cars on your shelves, and win the biggest share of the Metropolis television market — while keeping the company worth more than you started with.

goals.description: Operate at least 2 R&D centres — research compounds across labs.
Put televisions on a shelf — electronic parts, plastic and steel all have to come together.
Put cars on a shelf — the flagship product, sold at a premium.
Run an advertising campaign for televisions (Marketing, K) — brand awareness compounds.
Sell 35% of the televisions bought in Metropolis (trailing three months) — your technology lead has to show up in sales.
Be worth at least $100M when the scenario ends in December 2030 — research spending has to pay its way.
